fact: The Ministry of Lands is reviewing LIMS workflows and developing digital procedures to move the remaining manual land transactions onto the platform.
Malawi launched LIMS in February 2024, a web-based system linking Lands, Surveys and Physical Planning where registered users can view land parcels and assets.
Registered LIMS users can submit documents, receive notifications and make payments, including ground rent and application fees.

The Ministry of Lands, with the World Bank's AGCOM project, is implementing the Land Information Management System, with a contract signed 10 May 2021 for a 20-month rollout including data capture and go-live phases.
Lands Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu said the ministry's Land Information Management System, holding title deeds and other land data, was hacked about two weeks before 2026-10-27.
